rules.description: Checks that the percentage of deleted records for the entire import is within 0.1% threshold.
Checks that all 12 EDA StatVars are present and meet expected cohort freshness.

params.query: SELECT *, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_svs FROM stats WHERE StatVar IN ('Amount_Investment', 'Amount_Investment_EconomicAdjustmentAssistance', 'Amount_Investment_PublicWorks', 'Amount_Investment_ProgramPlanning', 'Amount_Investment_TechnicalAssistance', 'Amount_Investment_DistressedAreaRecompetePilotProgram', 'Amount_Investment_RegionalTechnologyAndInnovationHubs', 'Amount_Investment_RegionalInnovationStrategies', 'Amount_Investment_STEMTalentChallenge', 'Amount_Investment_TradeAdjustmentAssistance', 'Amount_Investment_ResearchNationalTechnicalAssistance', 'Amount_Investment_ScienceAndResearchParkDevelopmentGrants')
params.condition: total_svs = 12 AND CAST(SUBSTR(CAST(MaxDate AS VARCHAR), 1, 4) AS INTEGER) >= CASE WHEN StatVar IN ('Amount_Investment', 'Amount_Investment_EconomicAdjustmentAssistance', 'Amount_Investment_PublicWorks', 'Amount_Investment_ProgramPlanning', 'Amount_Investment_TechnicalAssistance', 'Amount_Investment_DistressedAreaRecompetePilotProgram', 'Amount_Investment_RegionalTechnologyAndInnovationHubs') THEN (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 1) WHEN StatVar IN ('Amount_Investment_RegionalInnovationStrategies', 'Amount_Investment_STEMTalentChallenge') THEN 2024 WHEN StatVar IN ('Amount_Investment_TradeAdjustmentAssistance', 'Amount_Investment_ResearchNationalTechnicalAssistance') THEN 2023 WHEN StatVar = 'Amount_Investment_ScienceAndResearchParkDevelopmentGrants' THEN 2015 ELSE 9999 END

rules.description: Checks that investment amounts are non-negative.
